purpose: Define a bounded XuanTie-E902 program-image delta gate on top of the named case.pat to IAHB instruction-memory mapping.
preconditions: config/scaling_gates/xuantie_e902_named_rom_memory_mapping.json passes through generated root field lowering
case.pat words are treated as the bounded program-image source for this gate
program-image deltas are lowered through x_iahb_mem_ctrl.ram0..3.mem rather than hand-written root byte offsets

program_image_delta_contract.word_index_mapping: program image word index i maps to x_iahb_mem_ctrl.ram0..3.mem[i]
program_image_delta_contract.byte_lane_order: testbench image order: ram0=word[31:24], ram1=word[23:16], ram2=word[15:8], ram3=word[7:0]
program_image_delta_contract.delta_scope: bounded byte mutations to the loaded instruction-memory image before or during resident eval steps
program_image_delta_contract.non_claim: not ISA/program correctness, not full software boot correctness, and not broad XuanTie family support

runtime_support.required_lowering: reuse named case.pat word/lane lowering to generated root field offsets for x_iahb_mem_ctrl.ram0..3.mem

resident_gpu_runs: lowered patch records are derived from program-image word/lane deltas, not hand-written root offsets
